lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's BOCC meeting, where commissioners take up two Land Use Code amendments — one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots, the kind of quiet code language that shapes development across the county for years. Also on Wednesday, HARC holds three separate preliminary public hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave, a large multi-building project in Backman Village worth paying attention to if you care about what gets built on that corner.

notable.stake: Three public hearings on large-scale Carhenge redevelopment, multiple new buildings proposed.
